@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion

REM ========================================
REM     PROMPD IDE - Standalone Launch
REM ========================================

echo.
echo ========================================
echo     PROMPD IDE - Standalone Launch
echo ========================================
echo.

REM Set the user data directory for this specific application
set "USER_DATA_DIR=%USERPROFILE%\.prompd-ide"

echo Starting Prompd IDE (Standalone Mode)...
echo Profile: %USER_DATA_DIR%

REM Launch with product configuration and isolated profile
"prompd-ide.exe" --product "product.prompd.json" --user-data-dir "%USER_DATA_DIR%" %*

echo.
echo Prompd IDE is now running in standalone mode!
echo This instance is completely isolated from VS Code.
echo.
pause
